I will keep this plot close to what worked for me before, because cash must also cover my maize land and school needs at home. Since this plot is intercropped and I own it, I will put manure there and only a small amount of chemical fertilizer, just enough to push it without spending too much. I will depend on the rains here in Iringa, use the seed I already trust, and I will hire a few people only when the weeding and planting work comes all at once.
